versions.quote: Evolution never ceases. Let us uncover the endless mysteries encoded in life itself.
versions.description: Architected for extreme environmental bio-adaptation, toxic waste transmutation, and cellular cellular immortality research. Mobius operates at the boundary of synthetic cybernetics and evolutionary biology.

workExperience.desc: Designs biological countermeasures against alien spores and deep-space extreme environments.
Engineered self-replicating nanocell lattices for emergency atmospheric scrubbers.

abilities.name: Ouroboros Slither Surge
abilities.desc: Manifests bio-luminescent serpents of energy devouring harmful chemical contaminants.

abilities.name: Evolutionary Re-Genesis
abilities.desc: Rapidly adapts armor and shielding properties to match the enemy's attack element.

abilities.name: Infinity Laboratory Field
abilities.desc: Accelerates bio-catalytic breakdown of environmental biohazards within a 45-meter radius.
